# local 0020: mcs51: since r17225, programs with --xstack do not link, because four library sources still name _spx

- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17228
- Recommended action: Apply the patch. Then decide about the C branch of mcs51-common/setjmp.c, which names spx and bpx as C objects.
- Patch: [local-0020.patch](../../patches/local-0020.patch), commit [`b147e6370`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/b147e63708a8f4a9777c354804f609691bb10288). Applies to r17228 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17228, a program for mcs51 with `--xstack` does not link. With the compiler and the
`mcs51-small` library of a default build of r17228, where `B` is the build tree:

```
$ cat empty.c
void main (void) { }
$ sdcc -mmcs51 --xstack --nostdlib -L$B/device/lib/build/mcs51-small mcs51.lib empty.c
?ASlink-Warning-Conflicting sdcc options:
   "-mmcs51 --model-small --xstack" in module "empty" and
   "-mmcs51 --model-small" in module "__sdcc_external_startup".
?ASlink-Warning-Undefined Global _spx referenced by module
```

The first warning is there because a default build does not make a library for `--xstack`. With
`--stack-auto --xstack` and the library of `make -C device/lib model-mcs51-small-xstack-auto`, the
second warning is the only output, and sdcc exits with status 1. The regression target
`mcs51-xstack-auto` uses that library, and each of its 2139 tests fails. 4817 test cases do not
link, and 65 do not compile. These two results are from a tree of r17228 with the other patches of
this report, which do not change the files that the Cause section names. The linker writes 0 for
the address of `_spx`, so the startup code stores the start of the external stack in r0 of
register bank 0 and not in `spx`.

## Cause

[r17225](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/17225/) changed the name of the external stack
pointer from `_spx` to `spx` in `src/mcs51/gen.c` and `src/mcs51/peeph.def`. It deleted
`device/lib/mcs51-common/_spx.c` and added `spx.s`, which defines `spx`. `crtxstack.s`,
`crtxpush.s`, and `crtxpop.s` in that directory and `device/lib/mcs51-small-xstack-auto/setjmp.c`
still name `_spx`. `crtxstack.s` has `__sdcc_init_xstack`, to which `_mcs51_genInitStartup()` in
`src/mcs51/main.c` refers for each program with `--xstack`. r17181 made the same correction for
`bp` and `bpx` in that `setjmp.c` after r17144.

## Fix

The patch changes `_spx` to `spx` in the four files. It makes the same change in the branch
`.ifdef __SDCC_USE_XSTACK` of `device/lib/mcs51-medium/_mullong.s`, which the library makefiles do
not assemble, and in three lines of `doc/sdccman.lyx` that list the startup code.

## Verification

A test is not added, because of the regression targets only `mcs51-xstack-auto` passes `--xstack`.
With the patch, the program above links without a warning. A program that has parameters, locals,
and registers on the external stack and calls `setjmp()` and `longjmp()` links and stores the
correct values in uCsim, with and without `--opt-code-size`. On `mcs51-xstack-auto`, 2059 of the
2139 tests pass, among them `setjmp`, and the log does not have the warning. In the libraries of
the six default mcs51 variants, the object files that differ are `crtxpop.rel`, `crtxpush.rel`,
and `crtxstack.rel`. mcs51-small and mcs51-large have 0 failures, with sizes and tick counts equal
to those without the patch. Host, the other mcs51 targets, and other ports were not run.

## Related

- In `device/lib/mcs51-common/setjmp.c`, the branch for libraries without `--stack-auto` declares
  `spx` and `bpx` as C objects under `__SDCC_USE_XSTACK`. That code names `_spx` and `_bpx`, which
  the library does not define. The library makefiles do not compile it with `--xstack`, and the
  patch does not change it.
- 80 tests fail on `mcs51-xstack-auto` with the patch. 15 of them are tests that the patch for
  bug #4253 corrected on r17200. 65 test cases do not compile with and without the patch.
